lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The board has changed. The train's been delayed.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Do we know how long the delay is?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thirty-five minutes. The new departure time is 10:55, and the estimated arrival is 12:05.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The platform number is flashing too.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. The departure has been moved to Platform 7. Platform 4 is closed for maintenance.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Good catch. I was looking at the time, not the platform.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: We can wait for the direct train, or take the 10:35 local and change at East Gate.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: When would the local route arrive?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: At 12:20, if the connection is on time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Is the 10:35 local definitely on time?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: It is right now, but the connection at East Gate is only eight minutes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's not much time if the station is busy.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then waiting is still faster, and we won't have to change trains with our bags.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Agreed. I'll let our host know. How about: “Our train has been delayed by thirty-five minutes. We're staying on the direct service and should arrive at 12:05.”

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Add the new platform in case she checks the train status.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Done. Now let's go to Platform 7.
